other_conditions: All kutcha households in the mining‑affected blocks of the listed 36 blocks across 9 districts of Odisha are eligible
Households that have previously received a house under any RH scheme are excluded
Households already living in a pucca house are excluded
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of up to ₹1,20,000 (non‑IAP) or ₹1,30,000 (IAP) for constructing a pucca house, along with wage components, latrine assistance and completion‑time incentives.
documents_required: Declaration of staying in a Kutcha house and construction on recorded land
